title: Clarence Muse and the Charleston Dandies at Birmingham's Gaiety Theatre
summary: He quit his show in Birmingham, joined Clarence Muse and the Charleston Dandies, and was housed by the theatre boss at the Gaiety.

bands.name: Clarence Muse and the Charleston Dandies

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: When we got down in Birmingham, Alabama, I think I quit...I quit this show. I went with the Clarence Muse Show.
Clarence Muse.
Clarence Muse. Clarence Muse and the Charleston Dandies, that was the name of the show.
Clarence Muse and the Charleston Dandies.
Moore (I) - 35

I quit(?) that show in a joint... I was playing drums in parades. The manager...the boss of the theatre must have liked what I was doing. The ..(?).. said, "I ain't got too much for me(?). If I (?) with you, I've got a theatre, so I can put you in the theatre. I'll give you forty dollars...[no]...I'll give you twenty-five dollars a week." And I wasn't getting...I was getting... Just about how much I was getting, I don't remember now. It wasn't no twenty-five dollars, though. So I quit this ...(?)...

About two or three days after I quit, I got... I took a room in a hotel, and the boss took care of the hotel bill for me. The other drummer... I guess he must have gave him his notice or something; I don't know what happened. But anyway, I was in there rehearsing the show in the theatre. The name of the... When it first started out, it was the Gaiety Theatre, Fourteenth Street and Fourth Avenue, Birmingham, Alabama.
Oh, this is Birmingham.
Birmingham.
And it was called the Gaiety Theatre.
The Gaiety Theatre. And it changed from the Gaiety to the Frolic.
You mean it was a different location or the same theatre...
Moore (I) - 36
Same theatre, but they changed the name.
They changed the name to the Frolic. I see.
Not the Gaiety, but Gay(?)... Oh, Gaiety Theatre, yes, uh-huh.
About how old were you when this happened? What was the name of this troupe or show...
The show I quit?
Yes.
It was Clarence Muse and the Charleston Dandies.
